style: Gritty science fiction military aesthetic, harsh lighting contrasts, metallic textures, explosive particle effects, dynamic motion blur. Deep red and electric blue faction colors, toxic green structures, orange nuclear fire highlights.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). Images 1, 3, 4 and 5 are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated (the preset is the closest match to how they look). Image 2 was regenerated because the old vignette had words painted on the buildings. Klein flagged its output twice, so it was made on Nano Banana 2 Lite: gen EradicationWars --model nano-banana-2-lite --only 2, then finish EradicationWars --only 2. The nexus thumbnail keeps its old name with a space (see projects.js).

images.prompt: Wide cinematic low-angle battle scene: red and blue armored mechas fighting over a devastated industrial landscape, massive green structures sheltering civilians, colossal mobile fortresses firing artillery in the middle distance, nuclear fireballs in a dark sky of fire.

Side view of a rocky battlefield laid out like a 2D platformer level, ground, ledges and steel towers in layers. A red armored robot soldier boosts diagonally through the air on bright thrusters, turning to aim a long rifle down at a blue armored robot soldier that slides across the ground below on sparking feet, both caught mid-motion. Behind them a colossal tracked fortress vehicle with many cannon turrets crawls along a ridge. Far away in a dusky sky, two lines of warships trade glowing beams. Dust, debris and bright tracer lines across the scene. Plain unmarked armor and walls. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.
Dynamic side view of a sleek starfighter-like mecha in flying form racing through a burning sky, thrusters trailing energy, large rifles mounted under its wings, nuclear explosions behind it.

Intense close-up portrait of a human pilot in a mecha cockpit wearing a tactical helmet with a reflective visor, determined expression, nuclear fire and battle debris visible through the canopy, red glow across the helmet.

Sweeping orbital view of a colonized star system at war: warship fleets crossing above a city-covered world, stations burning, a cracked planet in the distance, weapon fire and explosions across the scene.
